--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-                           D E S C R I P T I O N                              -
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This txt file contains the combined hard dataset flight IDs generated by
data_builder.py. Flights were selected from the full AOT dataset using all
filter criteria to isolate the most challenging sequences for model evaluation.
Results on this dataset provide an overall performance benchmark across all
hard scenario types.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-                           D A T A S E T   S T A T S                          -
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Total Flights : 1618

Small Object  : 662 flights contain at least one object with a bounding box
                 area <= 36.0 px² at some point during the sequence.

Below Horizon : 1053 flights contain at least one object at or below the
                 horizon, 301 of which also contain more than one object.

Multi-Object  : 627 flights contain more than one airborne object (planned
                 or unplanned) in at least one frame.

No Object     : 354 flights contain at least one frame where no airbrone object 
                 is present.

Average Sequence Length: 17.77s
